course.title: Principles of Environmental Engineering
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Design a septic tank for a family of 9 persons with a desludging interval of 4 (13) years and the average waste water flow of 10 L/capita/day. Also, design a soak pit for the disposal of the septic tank effluent. The soil is silty loam with a long-term infiltration rate of 24 $L / m ^ { 2 } .$ -day.
